u10-open.by: Densify (agent), clause-by-clause check against the Greek, 2026-10-09
u10-open.resolution: Checked each flag against the Greek; none is a meaning error. Fragment headings (Ps 143,4.5; 144,1; 144,4) are the edition's LXX lemmata. 'these words' supplies the subject of ταῦτα. προστίθεται 'is added' is rendered with its implied agent (the one praising). ὑπὲρ πάντα ἔπαινον τυγχάνοντα αὐτὰ ὁρῶσα = seeing them obtain (praise) beyond all praise, as rendered. τὸ γέννημα τὸ μονογενές σου = your only-begotten offspring; 'Son' is the referent, confirmed by the next clause (Χριστὸς θεοῦ δύναμις καὶ θεοῦ σοφία). The rest are participle style.

u10-open.by: Densify (agent), clause-by-clause check against the Greek, 2026-10-09
u10-open.resolution: Not meaning errors. κατὰ τὸν Ἐκκλησιαστήν is right: 'everything God made remains forever' is Ecclesiastes 3:14 (πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν ὁ θεός, αὐτὰ ἔσται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα), not Isaiah. 'likening the creative power in this way' keeps τὸ δημιουργικὸν and οὕτως.
